BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Plan the pipework before decorating

A radiator relocation can involve access under floors or behind finishes. If you are redecorating or changing flooring, mention the sequence of work when enquiring. A new radiator needs to suit the room’s heating requirements as well as the wall space available.

  • Show the current radiator and proposed new position.
  • Include dimensions of the available wall space.
  • Mention other work happening in the room.

Include your postcode and preferred timing. Confirm the agreed work, who supplies the fittings and any preparation or finishing tasks before booking.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Can a radiator move be planned with decorating?

Yes. Explain when flooring, painting or other work is scheduled so pipe access and the order of tasks can be discussed before the room is finished.

Do you welcome enquiries from Kinghorn and Burntisland?

Yes. These are within the wider Fife enquiry area. Send the postcode and scope of work to confirm availability.

Will a larger radiator fix a cold room?

The room, existing radiator, circulation and controls need to be considered together. Describe which rooms are affected rather than ordering a replacement based only on its size.
